context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12 without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (notes): coordinator 12:10 CST Nov 12, from its list of today's picks.
Based on (ruling): your guard cull ruling of Nov 10 15:04 CST (decision cull-guard-wrong-refusals, which guards with wrong refusals get fixed or deleted): a guard is deleted only when its wrong refusals cost more than the harm it stops; the coordinator judged these two meet that bar.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — the work it governs follows this pick.

options.gain: Their false alarms cost more than the harm they stop.
options.how: The guard cull lane deletes two checks: the one that asks for a Recovered line after a context reset, and the one that checks the dash in a Departs-from line. A third group of false alarms becomes a one-line note.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: The other route is not taken unless you choose b.

options.gain: The other route, if you prefer it.
options.how: Keep both checks and fix their false alarms instead.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: The governed work is redone or waits for the change.

reply: Reversed 12:57 CST by the coordinator after the retrospective audit found it wrong: the Recovered guard stays, half 2 of the stop-checks one-message change is restored, and the Departs-dash check is fixed. The lane is re-pointed.
short: Delete the Recovered-line and Departs-dash checks
title: Delete the Recovered-line and Departs-dash checks
